10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:3cec036e-eb22-49.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced machine learning engineer who instinctively spots gaps in AI reasoning and understands the complex realities of ML practice? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies machine learning expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable machine learning engineers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to machine learning, model development, implementation, and practical aspects of engineering work - Evaluate AI responses for technical accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world requirements - Draft realistic ML scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. engineer, product manager, client, or stakeholder) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated engineering content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects true ML engineering reasoning, authentic documentation, and practical procedures. Rather than conducting traditional engineering projects, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about the machine learning process at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level machine learning engineer with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in advising on, preparing, and executing machine learning projects and model deployments - Skilled at evaluating algorithms, implementation, and compliance with specifications - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your ML engineering expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to building advanced AI-powered engineering systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:46.description: POSITION SUMMARY The Project Manager oversees every detail of estimating costs and resources required to bid on and win residential and commercial construction contracts and provides the necessary support throughout the project life cycle to ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget. The Project Manager is also responsible for maintaining positive working relationships with each of Elite Pipeline's customers to understand their preferences and requirements, enabling successful scoping, pricing, winning, and delivering profitable work. Through close coordination with the production team and customers, the Estimator/Project Manager is critical to the successful execution of Elite Pipeline Services and project team. Position Overview As a Culinary Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience by combining culinary expertise, business acumen, and teaching skills. This role supports the culinary program, drives sales, delivers a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and helps build and manage a high-performing culinary team. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Supports the recruitment, training, and ongoing development of a high-performing team to meet the culinary business needs. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Provide in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensures an outstanding cooking class experience in every session by following provided recipes and game plans while holding employees accountable for quality and execution. · Work with store leadership to increase foot traffic and store engagement through cooking classes and private events. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist with driving sales growth by implementing strategies to enhance the culinary and retail business. · Analyze key performance metrics daily and leverage insights to optimize store performance. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:bb36d7ac-402.description: About Wing AI Wing AI is a technology-enabled talent platform helping businesses scale with high-quality global talent and AI-powered support. We manage the full talent lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding to training and performance so companies can focus on what matters most. Trusted by thousands of teams worldwide, Wing AI combines human expertise with smart systems to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable execution for modern businesses. Role Overview We are seeking a Corporate Recruiter to drive end-to-end hiring across key business functions at Wing AI. This role will play a critical part in scaling our internal teams by identifying, attracting, and hiring top-tier talent in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will partner closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand hiring needs, build strong pipelines, and ensure a seamless and high-quality candidate experience from sourcing to onboarding. jobgether-jobgether:lever:31c1ca7d-2e37-.title: Manual Test Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:31c1ca7d-2e37-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manual Test Engineer based in the United States. This remote role offers the opportunity to play a key part in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of healthcare software products. You will design, execute, and document comprehensive manual testing across complex, highly integrated systems. The role involves close collaboration with developers, business analysts, vendors, clients, and project teams to clarify requirements and resolve defects. You will contribute to test strategy, planning, execution, defect management, and overall software quality processes. Your work will be particularly valuable in healthcare payer environments, including Medicaid, Medicare, and MMIS/MES systems. The position combines detailed analytical work with direct stakeholder interaction in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. It is well suited to a QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and improving technology that supports critical healthcare programs. Design, develop, review, and execute comprehensive manual test cases and scenarios covering SIT, UAT, end-to-end, regression, and business process validation. Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements and translate them into detailed test conditions while ensuring complete requirements coverage. Create and maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) and identify test dependencies, risks, assumptions, and constraints. Execute manual testing across healthcare software, including user interfaces, workflows, eligibility processes, benefit determination, and complex integrated business processes. Document test results with clear evidence, maintain auditability, and communicate findings effectively to project and client stakeholders. Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects throughout the complete defect lifecycle. Participate in defect triage activities and collaborate with development, business, vendor, and project teams to investigate and resolve issues. Apply knowledge of defect severity, priority, root-cause analysis, remediation, and retesting procedures. Create, maintain, and coordinate test data required for SIT and UAT execution in collaboration with business, technical, and data conversion teams. Work closely with development teams to validate fixes and ensure that defects are resolved according to requirements. Contribute to comprehensive testing strategies, plans, environments, and quality processes under the direction of the Test Manager. Communicate regularly with customer and project stakeholders to clarify requirements, discuss defects, and support successful delivery. Requirements: 2–5 years of professional experience as a software tester, with at least 3 years of hands-on testing experience in large-scale systems or complex portfolios. Experience with U.S. healthcare payer systems, preferably MMIS/MES, Medicaid, Medicare, eligibility, benefits, or similarly integrated healthcare platforms. Strong understanding of HIPAA regulations and healthcare data privacy requirements. Proven experience developing and executing SIT, UAT, end-to-end, regression, and business process validation test scenarios and test cases. Ability to analyze complex business, functional, and technical requirements and convert them into comprehensive, traceable test coverage. Experience creating and maintaining Requirements Traceability Matrices and validating coverage against business requirements. Strong defect management skills, including identification, documentation, prioritization, tracking, triage, root-cause analysis, and retesting. Experience testing complex user interfaces, workflows, eligibility processes, benefit assessments, and determination processes. Ability to create and manage test data and coordinate data requirements across business, technical, and conversion teams. Understanding of database concepts and basic SQL

jobgether-jobgether:lever:342cebe5-9e00-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Construction Manager based in Canada. This is a high-impact construction leadership role overseeing multiple projects from initial planning through final completion. You will manage project scope, budgets, schedules, safety, quality, permitting, and contractor performance across a diverse regional portfolio. Working closely with senior leaders, operations teams, contractors, architects, engineers, vendors, and regulatory authorities, you will ensure projects move forward efficiently and meet business objectives. The role combines strategic planning, financial accountability, field oversight, and hands-on problem-solving. You will have significant ownership over project decisions while operating in a collaborative, stakeholder-focused environment. This is a remote opportunity for an experienced construction professional who is comfortable with substantial regional and national travel. Oversee construction projects from inception and preconstruction through execution, commissioning, final inspections, occupancy, and closeout. Develop comprehensive project plans covering schedules, responsibilities, risks, communications, stakeholders, and key milestones. Monitor project performance against safety, quality, cost, and schedule KPIs, proactively addressing issues and escalating material impacts promptly. Provide clear, timely, and transparent updates to internal leadership, operations teams, contractors, consultants, vendors, and other stakeholders. Direct general contractors, engineers, architects, and vendors to ensure contractual requirements, quality standards, and project timelines are achieved. Conduct site surveys and due diligence, develop scopes of work, prepare estimates and budgets, review invoices and change orders, and manage financial closeout. Lead design reviews to ensure plans and specifications accurately reflect approved project scope and requirements. Manage permitting activities and support discussions with regulatory authorities and other applicable governing bodies. Lead bidding and contractor-selection processes and provide recommendations based on project requirements, capabilities, cost, and performance. Provide field oversight throughout construction, ensuring work progresses safely, efficiently, and according to approved plans. Develop site-specific equipment take-offs and coordinate equipment ordering for individual projects. Track project completion percentages, turnover forecasts, actual costs, and projected costs through regular reporting. Hold vendors accountable for delivery, quality, schedule adherence, and correction of underperformance or deficiencies. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable environmental, accessibility, life-safety, and regulatory requirements. Coordinate commissioning and successfully hand over completed projects to operational stakeholders. Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure projects are closed in accordance with established procedures. Travel approximately 50–70% across Canada and, when required, other North American locations, typically involving 2–3 weeks per month and approximately 2–3 travel days per week. Requirements: Demonstrated experience in construction and project management, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or a high school diploma/GED combined with equivalent professional experience or 4+ years of U.S. military experience. Strong understanding of project planning, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, contractor management, procurement, and project closeout. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6e9a1af5-2515-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager based in Germany. Lead the engineering team responsible for the core capabilities at the heart of a global SaaS platform. You’ll own technical direction and delivery while helping modernize systems that support critical client workflows. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:ed81a38c-fd08-484.description: ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll be a core technical founder building the backend systems and infrastructure that power Known - from the APIs that will serve millions of requests, to the real-time communication pipelines that enable voice and text conversations, to the data architecture that supports intelligent matching at scale. You’ll design systems that are reliable, performant, and ready to grow with our user base. You’ll work closely with the founding team (AI/ML, fullstack, product, and design) to architect backend services that handle complex workflows — streaming LLM responses, batch matching jobs, payment processing, and real-time chat — while maintaining simplicity and developer velocity. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll make critical infrastructure decisions and set the technical foundation for Known’s growth. We believe the best technology is cutting-edge, respects teachers’ time, integrates into real classrooms, and helps educators focus on what matters most.
